exploit_name: Attacker can steal JackpotTicketNFTs from JackpotBridgeManager via unvalidated external call
description: The _bridgeFunds() function performs an unvalidated external call to a user-controlled address. Attacker supplies malicious call data targeting the NFT contract with safeTransferFrom() encoded data.
root_cause: The _bridgeFunds() function performs an unvalidated external call to a user-controlled address. Attacker supplies malicious call data targeting the NFT contract with safeTransferFrom() encoded data.
fix_description: Validate RelayTxData before external calls or restrict calls to whitelisted addresses only.
notes: Complete loss of user assets. Attacker steals NFTs and drains approved USDC via malicious callback.
